item.title: Week 10: Vikings at Packers
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: GB -2.5 · O/U 42.5 | Model GB 72% vs. market 57% | On paper, Green Bay has the edge, led by its passing game (4th of 32 in EPA per dropback, +0.26), while Minnesota counters with the league's top pressure rate (25%) against Green Bay's 22%, which ranks 12th. Jordan Love ranks 3rd of 31 in EPA per dropback versus Kirk Cousins at 12th, and the x-factor is Matthew Golden, who draws 29% of Green Bay's targets and 39% of its air yards against a Minnesota pass defense ranked 3rd. The model favors Green Bay at 72% win probability, mainly on the passing matchup (+4.2 points) and home field (+1.7 points).
